name: Balanced accuracy
aggregation: unweighted class recall then unweighted mean across 13 domains

name: Paired balanced-accuracy difference
aggregation: acquisition-aware minus selected classical per domain

name: Macro F1
aggregation: fold predictions pooled then class-unweighted F1

name: Per-class recall
aggregation: correct class predictions divided by class support

name: Instrument-balanced master BA
aggregation: average within instrument then equally across instruments

name: Selective risk
aggregation: error among accepted predictions by retained coverage

name: FPR at 95 percent known recall
aggregation: false unknown acceptance at fixed known recall

name: Target-adjusted instrument probe increment
aggregation: spectral probe cell-BA minus chemistry-null cell-BA

name: Target-adjusted sensor probe increment
aggregation: spectral probe cell-BA minus chemistry-null cell-BA

name: Cross-instrument same-master cosine distance
aggregation: mean pair distance after equal master weighting

name: Robustness degradation AUC
aggregation: area of BA loss versus perturbation magnitude

name: K-means metadata NMI
aggregation: normalized mutual information with target instrument sensor
